# Spec Delta: platform-interface

## Purpose

Defines what Sellbird requires from the shared platform so the two repositories can be built and verified independently.

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Platform contract document

The repository SHALL publish a platform interface document that specifies database provisioning, identity issuer and JWKS, minted claims, hostname and certificate ownership, overlay location and pin format, namespaces, and secret names.

#### Scenario: Contract is complete

- GIVEN the published contract document
- WHEN the contract check runs
- THEN every required section, secret name, claim, overlay path and pin format is present and well-formed

#### Scenario: Incomplete contract is rejected

- GIVEN a copy of the contract with the JWKS section removed
- WHEN the contract check runs
- THEN the check fails and names the missing section

### Requirement: AI credential contract

The platform contract SHALL define the AI brain credential as Secret `sellbird-claude` with key `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, consumed only as an environment variable and never persisted or logged.

#### Scenario: Credential source is the environment

- GIVEN the contract
- WHEN the AI credential section is read
- THEN it names the Secret and key and forbids file persistence and logging

### Requirement: Operator agreement

The contract SHALL be considered agreed only when the operator records an agreement decision.

#### Scenario: Agreement is a decision, not a file

- GIVEN a well-formed contract without an operator agreement decision
- WHEN phase closure is evaluated
- THEN the contract scenario is reported BLOCKED, not PASS

### Requirement: Required contract sections

The platform interface document SHALL contain every level-two section in the required-section list below, each with its exact heading.

#### Scenario: Every required section is checked by name

- GIVEN the published contract document
- WHEN the contract check runs
- THEN it confirms each heading in the required-section list and reports any missing one by name
- AND the required-section list is: Status and agreement; Ownership summary; Namespaces; Database provisioning; Identity (Kratos); Operator identity provisioning; Gateway (flint-gate); Issuer and JWKS; Minted claims; Route ownership; Hostname and certificate; Session cookie domain; Secrets; AI credential; Gateway configuration values; Overlay location and pin format; Argo CD ownership; Migration flow; NetworkPolicy; Rotation and revocation; Out of scope; Placeholders

### Requirement: Required contract names

The platform interface document SHALL name the Secrets `sellbird-db-migrate` and `sellbird-db-app` with key `SELLBIRD_DATABASE_URL`, the Secret `sellbird-claude` with key `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, the claims `iss`, `aud`, `sub`, `kid` and `exp`, the overlay file `apps/sellbird/overlays/production/kustomization.yaml`, the repository variable `SELLBIRD_PLATFORM_REPO`, and the hostname placeholder `sellbird.example.test`.

#### Scenario: Every required name is checked

- GIVEN the published contract document
- WHEN the contract check runs
- THEN it confirms each required Secret, key, claim, path, variable and placeholder, and reports any missing one by name

### Requirement: Least-privilege database provisioning

The contract SHALL require a `sellbird` database owned by a migration role `sellbird_migrate` and a runtime role `sellbird_app` that holds only data-manipulation privileges, with no superuser, role-creation or database-creation rights and no DDL, and SHALL keep the database single tenant with row-level security deferred.

#### Scenario: Runtime role grants exclude DDL

- GIVEN the database provisioning section
- WHEN its grants are read
- THEN the runtime role receives SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE through default privileges and no CREATE or ALL grant

### Requirement: Gate token contract

The contract SHALL define the flint-gate token Sellbird accepts: RS256 with a `kid` resolvable in a JWKS served at an in-cluster URL ending in `/.well-known/jwks.json`, an exact issuer string, `aud` equal to `sellbird`, `sub` equal to the Kratos identity id, and `exp` no more than 300 seconds after issue; and it SHALL state that Sellbird ignores cookies and unverified `x-flint-*` and forwarded headers.

#### Scenario: Claims are fully specified

- GIVEN the minted claims section
- WHEN each of iss, aud, sub, kid and exp is looked up
- THEN each has a defined value and the check Sellbird applies to it

### Requirement: Overlay pin format

The contract SHALL define the pin the deploy bot writes into the platform repository overlay as a `sellbird` images entry whose `newTag` is a 40-character lowercase hex commit SHA and whose `digest` is `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, changed together and never moved backwards.

#### Scenario: Example pin is well-formed

- GIVEN the overlay section's example kustomization
- WHEN its newTag and digest lines are matched against the stated formats
- THEN both match

### Requirement: Placeholders only in the public repository

The contract document SHALL use placeholders for every hostname, repository owner, platform repository name and identity id, and SHALL NOT contain a real hostname, email address or identity id.

#### Scenario: Real names are rejected

- GIVEN a copy of the contract containing a hostname that is not a placeholder
- WHEN the contract check runs
- THEN the check fails and names the hostname

+#    flint-forge Postgres only;
+# 4. extra egress for the app only: flint-gate JWKS (TCP 4456) and the public
+#    internet on the ports the model API and email providers use, never to
+#    cluster, private, shared-address or link-local ranges (so not the metadata
+#    server either).
+#
+# Peers are selected by the namespace's `kubernetes.io/metadata.name` label and
+# the pods' contract labels. Kubelet probes are not subject to these rules.
+#
+# If the cluster's pod or service ranges are outside the `except` list below,
+# the platform overlay patches the extra ranges in (they are cluster-specific
+# and do not belong in this public base).
+apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
+kind: NetworkPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: sellbird-default-deny
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: sellbird
+spec:
+  podSelector: {}
+  policyTypes:
+    - Ingress
+    - Egress
+---
+apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
+kind: NetworkPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: sellbird-app-ingress-from-flint-gate
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: sellbird
+spec:
+  podSelector:
+    matchLabels:
+      app.kubernetes.io/name: sellbird
+      app.kubernetes.io/component: app
+  policyTypes:
+    - Ingress
+  ingress:
+    - from:

+        # flint-gate namespace (two list items would mean OR).
+        - namespaceSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: flint-gate
+          podSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              app.kubernetes.io/name: flint-gate
+      ports:
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 5555
+---
+apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
+kind: NetworkPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: sellbird-egress-dns-and-postgres
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: sellbird
+spec:
+  # Every Sellbird pod: the app and the migration Job.
+  podSelector:
+    matchLabels:
+      app.kubernetes.io/name: sellbird
+  policyTypes:
+    - Egress
+  egress:
+    - to:
+        - namespaceSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
+          podSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              k8s-app: kube-dns
+      ports:
+        - protocol: UDP
+          port: 53
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 53
+    - to:
+        - namespaceSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: flint-forge
+          podSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              app.kubernetes.io/name: flint-forge-postgres
+      ports:
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 5432
+---
+apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
+kind: NetworkPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: sellbird-app-egress
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: sellbird
+spec:
+  podSelector:
+    matchLabels:
+      app.kubernetes.io/name: sellbird
+      app.kubernetes.io/component: app
+  policyTypes:
+    - Egress
+  egress:
+    # flint-gate JWKS (SELLBIRD_GATE_JWKS_URL).
+    - to:
+        - namespaceSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: flint-gate
+          podSelector:
+            matchLabels:
+              app.kubernetes.io/name: flint-gate
+      ports:
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 4456
+    # Model API, email providers (SMTP submission, IMAPS), prospecting.
+    - to:
+        - ipBlock:
+            cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
+            except:
+              - 10.0.0.0/8        # RFC 1918 (and typical GKE pod/service ranges)
+              - 172.16.0.0/12     # RFC 1918
+              - 192.168.0.0/16    # RFC 1918
+              - 100.64.0.0/10     # RFC 6598 shared address space (some cluster ranges)
+              - 169.254.0.0/16    # link-local, including the metadata server
+              - 127.0.0.0/8       # loopback
+      ports:
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 80
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 443
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 465
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 587
+        - protocol: TCP
+          port: 993

@@ -0,0 +1,217 @@
+# Sellbird's local stand-in for the hosted auth path (change
+# sellbird-gateway-route-config): Postgres 18 (flint-forge image), Ory Kratos,
+# flint-gate with Sellbird's route file, and the packaged Sellbird image in
+# gateway mode, all health-gated.
+#
+#   scripts/local/make-env.sh                         # fresh .env, keys, identities, cookies
+#   docker compose -f infra/local/compose.yaml up -d --wait
+#   docker compose -f infra/local/compose.yaml down -v   # cleanup
+#
+# Every credential comes from infra/local/.env and infra/local/.env.generated/,
+# both written per run by make-env.sh and never committed. Images are pinned by
+# digest; Sellbird is the locally built `sellbird:boundary`
+# (`docker build -t sellbird:boundary .`, Dockerfile owned by change
+# cluster-ready-container-image).
+#
+# Published on the host, loopback only:
+#   127.0.0.1:4456  flint-gate proxy (Host sellbird.example.test / auth.example.test)
+#   127.0.0.1:5555  Sellbird directly (the e2e test's negative controls)
+#   127.0.0.1:${SELLBIRD_LOCAL_PG_PORT}  Postgres (storage tests via scripts/local/dsn.sh)
+# Never published: Kratos admin (4434), Kratos public (4433, reached through
+# flint-gate's auth-host passthrough), flint-gate admin (4457, container loopback).
+#
+# Network aliases reproduce the in-cluster Service names of the platform
+# contract, so Sellbird's route file and JWKS URL are used verbatim.
+
+name: sellbird-local
+
+x-sellbird-hardening: &sellbird-hardening
+  image: sellbird:boundary
+  pull_policy: never
+  read_only: true
+  tmpfs:
+    - /tmp:rw,exec,nosuid,nodev
+  cap_drop: [ALL]
+  security_opt:
+    - no-new-privileges:true
+  init: true
+
+services:
+  postgres:
+    # flint-forge Postgres 18 (tribehealth/flint-forge-pg:18, multi-arch index,
+    # resolved 2026-11-18). Its own init scripts create the `flint` database's
+    # extensions; ours (50-*) then provisions Sellbird, Kratos and flint-gate.
+    image: tribehealth/flint-forge-pg@sha256:a0acdaa591095c6169d22a357d3b18f230eb7985c83688ab13e6afbe1b329f05
+    environment:
+      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
+      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}
+      # The image preloads pg_cron/pg_net for a database named `flint`.
+      POSTGRES_DB: flint
+      SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_PASSWORD: ${SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_PASSWORD:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}
+      SELLBIRD_APP_PASSWORD: ${SELLBIRD_APP_PASSWORD:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}
+      KRATOS_DB_PASSWORD: ${KRATOS_DB_PASSWORD:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}
+      FLINTGATE_DB_PASSWORD: ${FLINTGATE_DB_PASSWORD:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}
+    volumes:
+      - pg-data:/var/lib/postgresql
+      - ./postgres/50-sellbird-local.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/50-sellbird-local.sh:ro
+      - ../postgres/provision.sql:/sellbird-local/provision.sql:ro
+      - ./postgres/sellbird-test-db.sql:/sellbird-local/sellbird-test-db.sql:ro
+      - ./postgres/platform-dbs.sql:/sellbird-local/platform-dbs.sql:ro
+    ports:
+      - "127.0.0.1:${SELLBIRD_LOCAL_PG_PORT:-55432}:5432"
+    healthcheck:
+      # TCP (not the init-time socket) and the last database provisioning makes.
+      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d flintgate"]
+      interval: 3s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 60
+      start_period: 30s
+
+  kratos:
+    image: oryd/kratos@sha256:fe2428f103a6240c064b6ea77d3088610865c55fcebccb30355857eccdc25b4b  # v1.3.1
+    user: "${LOCAL_UID:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}:${LOCAL_GID:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}"
+    read_only: true
+    depends_on:
+      postgres:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    environment:
+      DSN: postgres://kratos:${KRATOS_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/kratos?sslmode=disable&max_conns=10
+    # Migrations are idempotent, so they run on every start before serving.
+    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-ec"]
+    command:
+      - >-
+        kratos migrate sql -e --yes
+        -c /etc/config/kratos/kratos.yml -c /etc/config/kratos-secrets/kratos-secrets.yml
+        && exec kratos serve
+        -c /etc/config/kratos/kratos.yml -c /etc/config/kratos-secrets/kratos-secrets.yml
+    volumes:
+      - ../kratos/kratos.yml:/etc/config/kratos/kratos.yml:ro
+      - ../kratos/identity.schema.json:/etc/config/kratos/identity.schema.json:ro
+      - ./.env.generated/kratos:/etc/config/kratos-secrets:ro
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:4434/admin/health/ready"]
+      interval: 3s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 60
+      start_period: 20s
+
+  flint-gate:
+    # ghcr.io/know-me-tools/flint-gate, the candidate digest recorded in
+    # flint-gate's k8s/overlays/ssr/PROVENANCE.md (linux/amd64 only; emulated on
+    # arm64 hosts).
+    image: ghcr.io/know-me-tools/flint-gate@sha256:e67abd80b024cd85dd1cbb2615ab940510aa3b48b48c86454b32c5a646398511
+    platform: linux/amd64
+    user: "${LOCAL_UID}:${LOCAL_GID}"
+    read_only: true
+    depends_on:
+      postgres:
+        condition: service_healthy
+      kratos:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    environment:
+      FLINT_GATE_CONFIG: /app/config/config.yaml
+      DATABASE_URL: postgres://flintgate:${FLINTGATE_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/flintgate?sslmode=disable
+      FLINT_GATE_REQUIRE_DATABASE: "true"
+      FLINT_GATE_JWT_KEY_PATH: /run/flint-gate/private.pem
+      FLINT_GATE_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH: /run/flint-gate/public.pem
+      RUST_LOG: info
+    # Seed the per-run RS256 key into jwt_signing_keys (the JWKS is served from
+    # there; the upsert by kid is idempotent), then serve.
+    entrypoint: ["/bin/bash", "-ec"]
+    command: ["flint-gate --database-init-only && exec flint-gate"]
+    volumes:
+      - ./.env.generated/flint-gate.yaml:/app/config/config.yaml:ro
+      - ./.env.generated/gate-keys:/run/flint-gate:ro
+    ports:
+      - "127.0.0.1:4456:4456"
+    networks:
+      default:
+        aliases:
+          - flint-gate.flint-gate.svc.cluster.local
+    healthcheck:
+      # The slim image has no curl: fetch the JWKS over bash's /dev/tcp and
+      # require the per-run kid, so "healthy" means Sellbird can verify tokens.
+      test:
+        - CMD
+        - bash
+        - -c
+        - >-
+          exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4456 &&
+          printf 'GET /.well-known/jwks.json HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n' >&3 &&
+          grep -q '"kid":"sellbird-local-rs256"' <&3
+      interval: 3s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 60
+      start_period: 30s
+
+  sellbird-migrate:
+    <<: *sellbird-hardening
+    # One-shot: apply Sellbird's migrations as the migration role. This
+    # container never receives the app role's DSN, and the app never this one.
+    command: ["storage", "migrate"]
+    restart: "no"
+    depends_on:
+      postgres:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    environment:
+      SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://sellbird_migrate:${SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/sellbird?sslmode=disable&application_name=sellbird-migrate
+    volumes:
+      - sellbird-migrate-data:/data
+
+  sellbird:
+    <<: *sellbird-hardening
+    command: ["dashboard", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "5555"]
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    depends_on:
+      sellbird-migrate:
+        condition: service_completed_successfully
+      flint-gate:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    environment:
+      # Gateway mode is selected here, inside the container only. It is never
+      # written to .env or the host shell (the baseline local-auth tests must
+      # not see it).
+      SELLBIRD_DASHBOARD_MODE: gateway
+      SELLBIRD_PUBLIC_HOST: sellbird.example.test
+      SELLBIRD_GATE_ISSUER: https://gate.example.test
+      SELLBIRD_GATE_AUDIENCE: sellbird
+      SELLBIRD_GATE_JWKS_URL: http://flint-gate.flint-gate.svc.cluster.local:4456/.well-known/jwks.json
+      SELLBIRD_GATE_ALLOWED_SUBS: ${SELLBIRD_GATE_ALLOWED_SUBS:?run scripts/local/make-env.sh}
+      SELLBIRD_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://sellbird_app:${SELLBIRD_APP_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/sellbird?sslmode=disable&application_name=sellbird
+    volumes:
+      - sellbird-data:/data
+    ports:
+      - "127.0.0.1:${SELLBIRD_LOCAL_DIRECT_PORT:-5555}:5555"
+    networks:
+      default:
+        aliases:
+          - sellbird.sellbird.svc.cluster.local
+    healthcheck:
+      # TCP connect, as the image's own HEALTHCHECK (gateway mode answers 400 to
+      # any request without the public Host), but polled fast for --wait.
+      test:
+        - CMD
+        - python
+        - -c
+        - "import socket; socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', 5555), timeout=3).close()"
+      interval: 3s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 60
+      start_period: 20s
+
+  # Tool, not a service: the Kratos admin client used by
+  # infra/kratos/create-identities.sh through `docker compose run`. The admin
+  # API is only reachable from inside this network.
+  kratos-admin-client:
+    profiles: ["tools"]
+    image: curlimages/curl@sha256:935d9100e9ba842cdb060de42472c7ca90cfe9a7c96e4dacb55e79e560b3ff40  # 8.17.0
+    entrypoint: ["curl"]
+    read_only: true
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt:
+      - no-new-privileges:true
+
+volumes:
+  pg-data:
+  sellbird-data:
+  sellbird-migrate-data:

+#
+# scripts/local/make-env.sh merges this file with Sellbird's route file,
+# infra/flint-gate/sellbird-routes.yaml (unmodified), into
+# infra/local/.env.generated/flint-gate.yaml: `sites` and `routes` are this
+# file's lists followed by the route file's; every other key comes from here.
+#
+# Secrets are not here. The database URL comes from DATABASE_URL and the RS256
+# key pair from FLINT_GATE_JWT_KEY_PATH / FLINT_GATE_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH, all set
+# by infra/local/compose.yaml from the uncommitted .env and a key generated per
+# run. Placeholders only: example.test hosts are not real.
+
+server:
+  listen: "0.0.0.0:4456"
+  # Admin API stays on the container's loopback: not published, not reachable
+  # from other containers, never routed. (No admin_auth is needed on loopback.)
+  admin_listen: "127.0.0.1:4457"
+  strict_agent_governance: true
+  tls:
+    enabled: false
+
+database:

+  max_connections: 5
+  override_yaml: false     # YAML routes can never be shadowed by DB routes
+
+cache:
+  l1:
+    max_capacity: 1000
+    ttl_seconds: 30
+
+jwt:
+  signing_algorithm: "RS256"
+  signing_key_path: "/run/flint-gate/private.pem"   # FLINT_GATE_JWT_KEY_PATH wins
+  signing_key_id: "sellbird-local-rs256"
+  issuer: "https://gate.example.test"
+  default_ttl_seconds: 300
+

+  kratos_session:
+    type: kratos
+    base_url: "http://kratos:4433"
+    forward_cookies: true
+    session_cookie: "ory_kratos_session"

+    type: anonymous
+    default_subject: "anonymous"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# First-init provisioning for the local stand-in's Postgres 18 (flint-forge image).
+#
+# Mounted into /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/ beside the image's own 01/02/99
+# scripts, so it runs exactly once, when the data volume is created
+# (scripts/local/make-env.sh always starts from a fresh volume). It runs as the
+# image's superuser over the local socket and applies:
+#
+#   1. infra/postgres/provision.sql, unmodified: roles sellbird_migrate and
+#      sellbird_app, database `sellbird`, the contract's grants and settings;
+#   2. sellbird-test-db.sql: database `sellbird_test` with the same owner and
+#      grants, for the boundary's storage test suite (which drops and recreates
+#      Sellbird's schema, so it must not share a database with the running app);
+#   3. platform-dbs.sql: the `kratos` and `flintgate` roles and databases that
+#      the platform would own in a hosted deployment.
+#
+# Passwords come from the container's environment (from the uncommitted .env).
+set -euo pipefail
+
+: "${SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_PASSWORD:?}" "${SELLBIRD_APP_PASSWORD:?}"
+: "${KRATOS_DB_PASSWORD:?}" "${FLINTGATE_DB_PASSWORD:?}"

+# Postgres for Sellbird
+
+Sellbird keeps its state in SQLite by default. A hosted install can keep it in
+Postgres 18 (the flint-forge image) instead: set `SELLBIRD_DATABASE_URL` to a
+`postgresql://` connection string for the runtime role and install the extra
+(`pip install 'sellbird[postgres]'`).
+
+| File | What it is |
+|---|---|
+| `provision.sql` | The database and its two roles, exactly as `docs/platform-interface.md` provisions them. The platform runs this in the shared cluster; use it for a local or test server. |
+| `../../migrations/postgres/` | The schema: numbered, reversible migrations (`NNNN_name.up.sql` / `.down.sql`). |
+
+## Roles
+
+- `sellbird_migrate` owns the schema. Only it runs `sellbird storage migrate`.
+- `sellbird_app` is what Sellbird runs as. It reads and writes rows; it cannot
+  create, alter, drop or truncate anything, and Sellbird refuses to start when
+  the schema version isn't the one its code expects.
+
+## Commands
+
+```bash
+# Apply pending migrations (migration role). Reads SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL,
+# else SELLBIRD_DATABASE_URL (the migration Job gets the migrate role's string there).
+sellbird storage migrate
+sellbird storage status
+# Operator-only rollback to a version (never automatic):
+sellbird storage down --to 4 --yes
+```
+
+## Running the storage tests against Postgres
+
+The contract tests run on SQLite always, and on Postgres when both of these
+point at a throwaway database provisioned with `provision.sql` (the tests drop
+and recreate Sellbird's schema there):
+
+```bash
+export SELLBIRD_TEST_PG_MIGRATE_DSN=postgresql://sellbird_migrate:...@127.0.0.1:5432/sellbird
+export SELLBIRD_TEST_PG_APP_DSN=postgresql://sellbird_app:...@127.0.0.1:5432/sellbird
+pytest tests/storage_contract tests/test_outbox_concurrency.py tests/test_send_safety_parity.py
+```
+
+The migration test compares `pg_dump --schema-only` before and after a full
+down and up, so `pg_dump` 18 must be on `PATH` (or named by
+`SELLBIRD_TEST_PG_DUMP`). With the DSNs unset the Postgres cases skip and say why.

+-- This is the provisioning in docs/platform-interface.md ("Database
+-- provisioning"), statement for statement. In the shared cluster the platform
+-- runs it once; use this file for a local or test server. Run it as a
+-- superuser with psql, passing the two passwords as variables (never commit
+-- them, never put them on a shared command line history):
+--
+--   psql "$SUPERUSER_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \
+--        -v migrate_password="$SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_PASSWORD" \
+--        -v app_password="$SELLBIRD_APP_PASSWORD" \
+--        -f infra/postgres/provision.sql
+--
+-- Then apply the schema as the migration role:
+--
+--   SELLBIRD_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://sellbird_migrate:...@host:5432/sellbird \
+--     sellbird storage migrate
+--
+-- and run Sellbird as the runtime role (SELLBIRD_DATABASE_URL with
+-- sellbird_app). The runtime role reads and writes rows and nothing else.
+-- Row-level security is not used: one workspace per database (ADR 0001).
+-- No extension is needed or created.
+

+
+CREATE ROLE sellbird_migrate LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE

+CREATE ROLE sellbird_app LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE
+  NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 20 PASSWORD :'app_password';
+CREATE DATABASE sellbird OWNER sellbird_migrate ENCODING 'UTF8' TEMPLATE template0;
+REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE sellbird FROM PUBLIC;
+GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE sellbird TO sellbird_app;

+  GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO sellbird_app;
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE sellbird_migrate IN SCHEMA public
+  GRANT USAGE, SELECT, UPDATE ON SEQUENCES TO sellbird_app;
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE sellbird_migrate IN SCHEMA public
+  GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS TO sellbird_app;
